title: Sleep planner & WHOOP models
description: WHOOP's sleep planner (when to go to bed) and its scores (sleep need and debt, performance, consistency, recovery, strain), rebuilt from a WHOOP strap's, a Fitbit's or a Garmin's own data by the WHOOP models connector.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the nights are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "whoop_model" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "whoop_model" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: input
list.label: Devices
list.description: The devices WHOOP's scores are rebuilt from.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "whoop_model" WITH KEY = "input" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "whoop_model" WITH KEY = "input" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: wake
list.label: Wake-up at
list.description: The wake-up the bedtimes are for (seconds after midnight).

options.content:
**WHOOP's sleep planner and scores, rebuilt from any device.** The *WHOOP models* connector reads each
device's nights and heart rate (a WHOOP strap through the Whoop connector, a Fitbit through fitbit-grafana, a Garmin
through garmin-grafana) and recomputes what the WHOOP app shows: the **sleep need** (a baseline, plus what the day's
strain adds, plus half of last night's shortfall), the **sleep performance**, the **consistency**, the **recovery**
(the night's HRV against its own 30-night mean) and the **day strain** (from the heart rate, for a device that has no
strain of its own). One line per device; a dashed grey line is the app's own value, where a strap writes it.
How the models were found and how close they come: docs/connectors/whoop_model.md.

panels.title: Tonight: when to go to bed
Peak (100 %): $input
panels.description: When to go to bed for the wake-up picked above: wake-up − sleep need ÷ the 14-night median efficiency − time to fall asleep. Today's strain adds to the need and is not known before the day ends: the bedtime at the strain so far, and at 8, 12 and 16.

targets.query: SELECT (86400 + $wake - 1 * last("need_s_so_far") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain so far", (86400 + $wake - 1 * last("need_s_strain8") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain 8", (86400 + $wake - 1 * last("need_s_strain12") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain 12", (86400 + $wake - 1 * last("need_s_strain16") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain 16" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" = '$input' AND time > now() - 7d

panels.title: Perform (85 %): $input
panels.description: When to go to bed for the wake-up picked above: wake-up − 0.85 × sleep need ÷ the 14-night median efficiency − time to fall asleep. Today's strain adds to the need and is not known before the day ends: the bedtime at the strain so far, and at 8, 12 and 16.

targets.query: SELECT (86400 + $wake - 0.85 * last("need_s_so_far") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain so far", (86400 + $wake - 0.85 * last("need_s_strain8") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain 8", (86400 + $wake - 0.85 * last("need_s_strain12") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain 12", (86400 + $wake - 0.85 * last("need_s_strain16") * 100 / last("efficiency") - last("latency_s")) % 86400 AS "strain 16" FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" = '$input' AND time > now() - 7d

panels.title: Sleep need tonight at strain 12
panels.description: Baseline + what a day at strain 12 adds + the debt carried from last night.

targets.query: SELECT last("need_s_strain12") / 3600 FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Debt carried from last night
panels.description: Half of last night's shortfall (need − sleep); 9/14 after a night scored above 87.

targets.query: SELECT last("debt_s") / 60 FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Strain so far
panels.description: Today's cycle, from last night's sleep onset: WHOOP's own for a strap, from the heart rate otherwise.

targets.query: SELECT last("strain_so_far") FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: Last night
panels.description: Whether the device had synced the whole of last night when the model last ran: a partial night has too little sleep, and its debt is too high until the next run.

targets.query: SELECT last("partial") FROM "whoop_model_tonight" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND time > now() - 7d GROUP BY "input"

panels.title: WHOOP's scores, rebuilt from each device
Recovery
panels.description: The app's recovery and the model's: 100·σ(h·(ln HRV − its 30-night mean) + p·performance + c).

targets.query: SELECT mean("recovery_score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("recovery") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Day strain
panels.description: The cycle that starts with the night (sleep onset to the next one): WHOOP's own for a strap; from the heart rate otherwise, a·ln(1 + Banister's TRIMP / b).

targets.query: SELECT mean("strain") FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("day_strain") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep need
panels.description: Baseline + strain + debt − naps: the app's own sum, and the model's.

targets.query: SELECT (mean("need_baseline_s") + mean("need_strain_s") + mean("need_debt_s") - mean("need_nap_s")) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("need_s") / 3600 FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep debt carried into the night
panels.description: The share of the nights before still owed.

targets.query: SELECT mean("need_debt_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("need_debt_s") / 60 FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep performance
panels.description: The app's sleep performance, and the model's: sleep against need, efficiency and consistency.

targets.query: SELECT mean("score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("sleep_score") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep consistency
panels.description: How much the night's sleep window overlaps the four before it.

targets.query: SELECT mean("consistency_pct") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" = 'night' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("consistency") FROM "whoop_model" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "input" =~ /^${input:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "input" fill(none) tz('$tz')
